compare_topics.description: Compare how much the Guardian is writing about several subjects (two to five of them) over the same window, ranked, each with its share of the combined coverage and its newest headline. count_articles.description: Count how much the Guardian has published on a subject, and name the newest piece. It costs a single request whether the answer is three articles or thirty thousand, so it is the cheap check to branch a workflow on: alert someone when coverage of your organisation spikes, or skip the rest of the run when there is nothing new.

description: Read The Guardian with its own Open Platform API: every article, video, gallery and live blog it has published since 1999, plus the tags, sections and regional editions behind them. Search the archive by words, phrase, section, tag, journalist or date range, follow a subject over a rolling window for a scheduled workflow, count how much is being written about it and compare several subjects side by side, pull one article's full text and pictures, follow a live blog update by update, and read the editors' picks and most-viewed lists from any edition's front page.
